title: Flight template editor below constraints at full page width

review.missedScope: Actual owner viewport is accepted. Other desktop/mobile viewports were not manually checked; existing narrow-screen CSS is preserved. Residual import flights were tracked separately and owner has now confirmed disappearance.
review.rootCause: Template editor was placed in the smaller 0.8fr column beside constraints, while its fields required more width; separate vertical full-width sections remove that container restriction.
review.earlyDetection: Before placing a data editor in a split layout, compare container space with row minimum widths and verify the final rightmost action on the real page with long content. Preserve command-ID and input-immutability regression.
